say:3:1012605001:1.source_cn: 阿爸，这些大哥哥大姐姐是谁？

say:4:1012605002:1.text: My boy, let's thank these heroes who have helped save Timberhide.
say:4:1012605002:1.source_cn: 来，孩子，我们一起感谢这些林隐村的恩人，是他们清理了魔物。

say:5:1012605003:1.text: Thank you so much! Timberhide is grateful!
say:5:1012605003:1.source_cn: 谢谢大哥哥大姐姐们！林隐村给你们添麻烦了！

say:6:1012605004:1.text:
It's our duty. If you want to thank someone, thank Magister Merlin.
Bryon, did you notice anyone else in the cave?
say:6:1012605004:1.source_cn: 这是我们的职责，事后要感谢就谢梅林吧。\n布莱恩，刚才...
say:6:1012605004:1.male:
It's our duty. If you want to thank someone, thank Magister Merlin.
Bryon, did you notice anyone else in the cave?
say:6:1012605004:1.female:
It's our duty. If you want to thank someone, thank Magister Merlin.
Bryon, did you notice anyone else in the cave?

say:9:1012605005:1.text: Well, those people are very scared, so I stayed silent in order not to alarm them.
say:9:1012605005:1.source_cn: 有，那些人都很害怕，为了不惊动他们我没有声张。

say:10:1012605006:1.text: My child, are all the villagers who escaped with you here?
say:10:1012605006:1.source_cn: 孩子，和你一起逃出来的村民都在这里吗？

say:11:1012605007:1.text: Yes! Someone is injured. I came out to find some medicinal herbs!
say:11:1012605007:1.source_cn: 是的！有人受伤了，我是为了找药草才出来的！

say:14:1012605008:1.text: He is fearless. You have a brave son, Chief Ivan.
say:14:1012605008:1.source_cn: 我们看到了他刚才的无畏，你有个勇敢的儿子，伊凡。

say:15:1012605009:1.text: Yes, this child will definitely become a great village chief in the future. Better than I will ever be...
say:15:1012605009:1.source_cn: 是啊，这孩子将来一定会成为个好村长，至少比我要称职……

say:16:1012605010:1.text: Take us to other villagers. We will find a solution for medicine together.
say:16:1012605010:1.source_cn: 带我们去找其他村民吧，药草的事我们一起想办法。
